title: Aletheia Audit Receipt v1
description: Machine-readable adversarial verification receipt produced by an independent Tomography Verifier (G_obs) and validated by `aletheia audit-check`.

date.description: UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the audit completed.

author.description: Role or agent that authored the audited artifact.

verifier.description: Independent verifier role or agent identifier.

target.description: Audited artifact path, repository/PR, or theorem claim.

oracle_class.description: Primary verification oracle class (or '+'-joined combination of exact, sampled, anchor).

novelty.description: Honest novelty classification (default N0 until full-text prior-art audit confirms N1 or N2).

repro_command.description: Clean-room command reproducing the audit under isolated flags (-I -O -B -W error).

r4_parity.description: True iff exit code and canonical output match across -I -B, -I -O -B, and -I -B -W error with zero bare asserts.

prior_art_checked.description: True iff full-text prior art and live peer PRs were inspected (mandatory true whenever novelty includes N2).

scope_limits.description: Explicit scope caveats (e.g. local arc vs global, uncompiled_source, high-SNR limit, ensemble vs single-shot).

evidence.description: Concise factual audit evidence, counterexamples, and clean-room verifier script reference.
